predict_A.disclaimer: Research use only (BTECH CAP 501 academic project). Estimates reproduce Transfermarkt community valuations, which may themselves be biased, for players at clubs in 14 European first divisions (2025-26 snapshot). Not suitable for scouting, recruitment, contract or any decision about a person. Nationality is not used by the model; see the project's fairness audit.

explain_A.method: SHAP TreeExplainer (path-dependent) on the served gradient-boosting regressor, log-value scale. One-hot, missing-indicator and age-squared columns are summed back to the input feature. Contributions add up exactly to the prediction: base + sum = predicted log value. They describe how this model arrived at this estimate, not what causes market value.
